[FACT] User has planted 12 new tomato saplings.  
[PREFERENCE] User is excited to see their tomato plants grow.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Congratulations on planting your new tomato saplings!  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Tomatoes love well-draining, fertile soil with a pH between 6.0 and 6.8.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Water tomatoes deeply once or twice a week, depending on weather conditions.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Mulch around the plants with organic materials like straw, bark chips, or grass clippings around 2-3 inches thick.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Keep the area clean by removing debris, weeds, or infested plants.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Regularly inspect plants for signs of pests like aphids, whiteflies, hornworms, and spider mites.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Use neem oil or insecticidal soap to control infestations.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Inspect plants for signs of fungal diseases like blight, septoria leaf spot, or powdery mildew.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Rotate tomato plants to a different location each season to avoid nutrient depletion and disease buildup.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Provide support using tomato cages, trellises, or stakes to keep them upright.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Prune tomato plants to encourage bushy growth and increase fruit production.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Tomatoes need at least 6 hours of direct sunlight per day.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Feed tomato plants with a balanced fertilizer (e.g., 10-10-10 NPK) once a month.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Regularly remove weeds to promote healthy growth.  
[PREFERENCE] User is considering using neem oil and insecticidal soap to control aphids and whiteflies on their tomato plants.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Neem oil is effective against a wide range of pests, including aphids and whiteflies.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Neem oil is absorbed by the plant and has low toxicity for beneficial insects.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Insecticidal soap is particularly effective against soft-bodied pests like aphids and whiteflies.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Using neem oil and insecticidal soap together can have a synergistic effect.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Always read and follow label instructions for neem oil and insecticidal soap.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Water tomato plants in the morning to give them the entire day to absorb the water.
